items.reason: A lower-strength retinol is a sensible starting point for visible fine lines.
Retinol makes daily sunscreen important, and this mineral SPF 50 is a simple morning step.
Your scan shows low moisture, and this barrier moisturizer helps skin feel comfortable while it adjusts to retinol.

response.routine_note: Start the retinol serum 2 to 3 nights a week on dry skin, followed by the moisturizer, and build up slowly as skin feels comfortable. Apply the mineral SPF every morning and reapply when outdoors.
